Class TransferSpan

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.common.telemetry.TransferSpan
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class TransferSpan extends Object implements Serializable
Bounded, SDK-independent wire representation of a completed Mover span. Receivers must call snapshot() before admitting a deserialized bean. Only operational identifiers and counters are permitted, never URLs or errors.
